red_turret_select_pointing.pro


Routines

top source red_turret_select_pointing

SST pipeline

result = red_turret_select_pointing(turretdata, pointingtype, isodate [, time=dblarr])

Return value

An array with pointing coordinates.

Parameters

turretdata in type=structarr

A struct array with info from the turret logfile. The turret program stores pointing information of different types depending on what it's doing, these types are tagged in different ways.

pointingtype in type=string

The pointing type tag to select, one of "Stonyhurst", "Disk", "Flat", or "Pointing". If "Pointing", information from the former three types are combined and returned as cartesian disk coordinates.

isodate in type=string

The date in ISO format. (Needed only if we need to convert Stonyhurst coordinates from old turret logfiles.)

Keywords

time in out optional type=dblarr

This is an array of time coordinates in s after midnight. If given as input, the returned pointing coordinates will be interpolated to those points in time. If not, it is simply returned as the time coordinate in turretdata.
